* Subcutaneous edema in prepatellar region and popliteal region.
* Interstitial hyperintensity signal of ACL, in favor of grade 1 injury.
> No significant bone marrow edema or active cortical destruction noted at distal femur and proximal tibia and fibula in this study.
> No significant myositis noted at distal thights to proximal legs.
> The contour of PCL, MCL & LCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> No evidence of tear is noted in either medial or lateral meniscus in this study.
> No evidence of bone contusion is noted.
> Wearing of articular cartilage of patella, major at patellar ridge,in favor of grade 2-3 chondromalacia,
Impression:
1. Baker's cyst and R/O rupture with perifocal edema over popliteal fossa to proximal leg.
2. Subcutaneous edema in prepatellar region and popliteal region.
3. Grade 2-3 patellar chondromalacia
4. Grade 1 injury of ACL.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation.
